scheme_name: National Award For Senior Citizens (Vayoshreshtha Samman): Lifetime Achievement
other_conditions: Nominee must be a senior citizen aged seventy years or above
Nominee must have made significant contributions to the upliftment of elderly people, including achievements in education, research, publication, or innovative social‑welfare programmes
Nominee should be recognised as a role model for exemplary contribution to society
Nominee must be recommended in writing by an authorized person; self‑nominations are not accepted
Awards are open to all Indian institutions, organizations and individuals without discrimination on religion, race, sex, caste or creed
benefits_summary: Award includes a citation, a memento, and a cash prize of ₹2,50,000, with travel, lodging and allowance expenses covered for the awardee and one companion.
